blocks.text: O'tgan darsda **like** + ot bilan o'xshatishni ko'rdik: It looks **like** a palace (→ 117-dars). Endi o'xshatishdan keyin to'liq **gap** kelsa nima bo'lishini ko'ramiz. Buning uchun **as if** yoki **as though** (ma'nosi bir xil) ishlatiladi, norasmiy nutqda esa **like** ham: You look **as if** you're tired. O'zbekchada bunga ikki xil qolip to'g'ri keladi: taxmin — «**-ganga o'xshaydi**», «**shekilli**»; o'xshatish — «**xuddi ... -gandek**», «**go'yo**».

rows: It looks **as if** it's going to rain.
I feel **as if** I'm getting a cold.

blocks.text: look / sound / feel / seem as if: taassurot

Biror narsani ko'rib, eshitib yoki his qilib xulosa chiqarganda **look / sound / feel / seem + as if** ishlatiladi. Agar taassurot **rost bo'lishi mumkin** bo'lsa, gapdagi zamon odatdagidek: It looks **as if** it**'s going to** rain (rostdan yog'ishi mumkin). Ko'pincha ega sifatida **it** keladi, lekin odam ham bo'ladi: You sound **as if** you've got a cold. **like** + gap og'zaki nutqda keng tarqalgan (It looks **like** we're late), yozma matnda **as if / as though** afzal.

items.text: You look **as if** you need a cup of tea.
It sounds **as though** Madina is on the phone with her mum again.
items.translation: Madina yana onasi bilan telefonda **gaplashayotganga o'xshaydi**.

items.text: It looks **like** the last bus isn't coming tonight.

blocks.text: **as if** istalgan fe'ldan keyin kelib, harakat **qanday** bajarilganini tasvirlaydi: behave / act / talk / run / eat / look at somebody **as if** ... — «**xuddi ... -gandek**». Taassurot oldinroq bo'lgan voqeaga tegishli bo'lsa — **Past Perfect** (yoki hozirgi vaqtga nisbatan — Present Perfect): She carried on **as if** nothing **had happened**. Past Perfect haqida → 15-dars.

items.text: He drives **as if** he's in a Formula 1 race.
She smiled at us **as though** nothing had happened.

blocks.text: as if + o'tgan zamon: haqiqatga zid

Agar o'xshatish **haqiqatga zid** bo'lsa (aslida unday emas), as if dan keyin zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi — hozirgi holat haqida ham **Past Simple** ishlatiladi: He talks **as if** he **knew** everything (aslida hamma narsani bilmaydi). Bu if I knew ... dagi xayoliy o'tgan zamonning aynan o'zi (→ 39-dars). be fe'li rasmiy uslubda barcha shaxslarda **were**: **as if** I **were** a child; og'zaki nutqda **was** ham ishlatiladi.

rows: He looks **as if** he **is** ill. (balki rostdan kasaldir)
He talks **as if** he **were** a doctor. (u shifokor emas)
It sounds **as if** they **know** each other.
She acts **as if** she **knew** everyone. (hammani tanimaydi)
You look **as if** you **have** a temperature.
He spends money **as if** he **had** millions. (millionlari yo'q)

items.text: My cousin talks **as if** he knew everything about cars.
items.translation: Amakivachcham **xuddi** mashinalar haqida hamma narsani **biladigandek** gapiradi.

items.text: Don't look at me **as if** I were a stranger.

blocks.text: Adashtirmang: **feel like** + ot / -ing — «**... ni xohlamoq**», «**... gim kelyapti**»: I **feel like** a coffee; I don't **feel like** going out tonight. Bu o'xshatish emas. Og'zaki nutqdagi yakka **As if!** esa kinoya: «Ha, shunaqa bo'lardi!», «Qayoqda!».

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: 1) «He looks **like** tired» → He looks **tired** yoki He looks **as if** he's tired (like dan keyin sifat kelmaydi). 2) «**like as if**», «**as like**» → **as if** yoki **like** (ikkalasi birga emas). 3) Haqiqatga zid o'xshatishda hozirgi zamon: «He behaves as if he **is** the director» (u direktor emas) → as if he **was / were** the director. 4) Rasmiy yozuvda like + gap: «It seems like the results are wrong» → It seems **as if / as though** the results are wrong.

Tarjima bo'yicha tanlang: «**-ganga o'xshaydi**», «**shekilli**» (rost bo'lishi mumkin) — as if + **oddiy zamon**; «**xuddi ... -gandek**», «**go'yo**» (aslida unday emas) — as if + **o'tgan zamon**. Bitta ishonchli belgi: gapdan keyin «aslida unday emas» deb qo'shish mumkin bo'lsa — o'tgan zamon.

rows: He ran **as if** he was late.

examples.title: **Look** / **sound as if** ...: an impression
examples.description: Ko'rinish yoki ovozga qarab xulosa: look / sound as if (= as though, like) + gap. Taassurot rost bo'lishi mumkin — odatdagi zamon.

sentences.text: Look at those black clouds — it looks **as if** we're in for a storm.
sentences.translation: Anavi qora bulutlarga qara — bo'ron **bo'ladiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: You look **as if** you haven't slept for days — is everything all right?
sentences.translation: Bir necha kundan beri **uxlamaganga o'xshaysan** — hammasi joyidami?

sentences.text: Aziz sounded **as though** he had a bad cold when I phoned him.
sentences.translation: Qo'ng'iroq qilganimda, Azizning ovozi qattiq **shamollaganga o'xshardi**.

sentences.text: The restaurant looks **like** it's closed — all the lights are off.
sentences.translation: Restoran **yopiqqa o'xshaydi** — barcha chiroqlar o'chiq.

sentences.text: It sounds **as if** the neighbours are having another party upstairs.
sentences.translation: Yuqoridagi qo'shnilar yana **ziyofat qilayotganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza looked **as though** she was about to cry, so I changed the subject.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **yig'lab yuboradigandek** ko'rindi, shuning uchun gapni boshqa yoqqa burdim.

sentences.text: That old bridge looks **as if** it might collapse at any moment.
sentences.translation: U eski ko'prik har lahzada **qulab tushadigandek** ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: From your voice, it sounds **like** you've had a really tough day.
sentences.translation: Ovozingdan juda og'ir kun **o'tkazganga o'xshaysan**.

sentences.text: Does it look **as if** the match will be cancelled because of the rain?
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir tufayli o'yin **bekor qilinadiganga o'xshayaptimi**?

sentences.text: The kitchen smelled **as if** someone had burnt the toast again.
sentences.translation: Oshxonadan **xuddi** kimdir yana nonni **kuydirgandek** hid kelardi.

examples.title: **Feel** / **seem as if** ...: feelings and impressions
examples.description: feel as if — ichki his: «... -gandek his qilaman». seem as if / it feels as if — umumiy taassurot.

sentences.text: I feel **as if** I've known you for years, although we only met yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kecha tanishgan bo'lsak ham, seni yillardan beri **bilgandek** his qilyapman.

sentences.text: It feels **as though** summer has finally arrived in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga nihoyat yoz **kelgandek** tuyulyapti.

sentences.text: After the long flight, Sarah felt **as if** her legs were made of stone.
sentences.translation: Uzoq parvozdan keyin Sara oyoqlari **xuddi** toshdan **yasalgandek** his qildi.

sentences.text: It seems **as if** everyone in the office knows about the merger except me.
sentences.translation: Ofisda mendan boshqa hamma birlashuv haqida **biladiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Jasur felt **as though** the whole stadium was watching him take the penalty.
sentences.translation: Penalti tepayotganda Jasur **go'yo** butun stadion unga **qarab turgandek** his qildi.

sentences.text: My head feels **as if** it's going to explode after that meeting.
sentences.translation: O'sha yig'ilishdan keyin boshim **yorilib ketadigandek**.

sentences.text: Doesn't it seem **as if** prices go up every single month now?
sentences.translation: Hozir narxlar har oy **oshayotganga o'xshamaydimi**?

sentences.text: The flat felt **as if** nobody had lived there for years.
sentences.translation: Kvartirada **go'yo** yillar davomida hech kim **yashamagandek** edi.

sentences.text: Some days it feels **like** the working week will never end.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi kunlari ish haftasi hech qachon **tugamaydigandek** tuyuladi.

sentences.text: Kate felt **as if** a huge weight had been lifted from her shoulders when she resigned.
sentences.translation: Ishdan ketgach, Keyt yelkasidan katta yuk **tushgandek** his qildi.

examples.title: **As if** with other verbs: behave, talk, run
examples.description: as if harakat tarzini tasvirlaydi: behave / act / talk / run / eat as if ... — «xuddi ... -gandek».

sentences.text: Tom ran to the station **as if** his life depended on it.
sentences.translation: Tom vokzalga **xuddi** hayoti shunga **bog'liqdek** yugurdi.

sentences.text: The children ate their dinner **as if** they hadn't eaten for a week.
sentences.translation: Bolalar kechki ovqatni **xuddi** bir haftadan beri hech narsa **yemagandek** yeyishdi.

sentences.text: Madina treats her cat **as though** it were a member of the family.
sentences.translation: Madina mushugiga **xuddi** oila **a'zosidek** qaraydi.

sentences.text: Don't shout at me **as if** it's all my fault!
sentences.translation: **Xuddi** hammasiga men **aybdordek** menga baqirma!

sentences.text: Our new colleague acts **as if** he's been working here for years.
sentences.translation: Yangi hamkasbimiz o'zini **xuddi** bu yerda yillardan beri **ishlayotgandek** tutadi.

sentences.text: When the teacher came in, the students sat down **as if** nothing was going on.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi kirganda, talabalar **xuddi** hech narsa **bo'lmayotgandek** o'tirib olishdi.

sentences.text: James spends money **as though** there's no tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Jeyms pulni **xuddi** ertasi **yo'qdek** sovuradi.

sentences.text: She held the newborn baby carefully, **as if** it might break.
sentences.translation: U yangi tug'ilgan chaqaloqni **xuddi** sinib **qoladigandek** ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'tardi.

sentences.text: Why are you looking at me **as if** I've said something stupid?
sentences.translation: Nega menga **xuddi** ahmoqona gap **aytgandek** qarayapsan?

sentences.text: The wind was howling **as though** a terrible storm was coming.
sentences.translation: Shamol **xuddi** dahshatli bo'ron **kelayotgandek** uvillardi.

examples.title: **As if** + past perfect: as if nothing had happened
examples.description: Taassurot oldinroq bo'lgan voqeaga oid bo'lsa — as if + Past Perfect (hozirgi holatda — Present Perfect).

sentences.text: After the argument, Bekzod carried on working **as if** nothing had happened.
sentences.translation: Janjaldan keyin Bekzod **xuddi** hech narsa **bo'lmagandek** ishlashda davom etdi.

sentences.text: Emma's face went white, **as though** she had seen a ghost.
sentences.translation: Emmaning yuzi oqarib ketdi, **xuddi** arvoh **ko'rgandek**.

sentences.text: You look **as if** you've just won the lottery — what's happened?
sentences.translation: **Xuddi** lotereya **yutgandek** ko'rinyapsan — nima bo'ldi?

sentences.text: After the teenagers' party, the house looked **as though** a bomb had hit it.
sentences.translation: O'smirlarning ziyofatidan keyin uy **xuddi** bomba **tushgandek** ko'rinardi.

sentences.text: Oliver greeted me **as if** we had never met before.
sentences.translation: Oliver men bilan **xuddi** ilgari hech qachon **uchrashmagandek** salomlashdi.

sentences.text: Nilufar's English sounds **as though** she has lived in London all her life.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning inglizchasi **xuddi** butun umri Londonda **yashagandek** eshitiladi.

sentences.text: When I saw the bill from the garage, I felt **as if** I'd been robbed.
sentences.translation: Ustaxonaning hisobini ko'rganimda, **xuddi** meni **talashgandek** his qildim.

sentences.text: Her room looked **as if** nobody had cleaned it for months.
sentences.translation: Uning xonasi **xuddi** oylab hech kim **tozalamagandek** ko'rinardi.

sentences.text: Grandpa talks about the 1970s **as though** it all happened yesterday.
sentences.translation: Bobom 1970-yillar haqida **xuddi** hammasi kecha **bo'lib o'tgandek** gapiradi.

sentences.text: Why do you look **as if** you've lost your best friend?
sentences.translation: Nega **xuddi** eng yaqin do'stingni **yo'qotgandek** ko'rinyapsan?

examples.title: Unreal: **as if** he knew, **as if** I were
examples.description: O'xshatish haqiqatga zid bo'lsa — as if + o'tgan zamon, hozirgi holat haqida ham: as if he knew (aslida bilmaydi). Rasmiyroq — were barcha shaxslarda.

sentences.text: Jasur talks about football **as if** he knew everything about it, but he's never played.
sentences.translation: Jasur futbol haqida **xuddi** hamma narsani **biladigandek** gapiradi, lekin hech qachon o'ynamagan.

sentences.text: My boss gives me orders **as if** I were his personal assistant.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'im menga **xuddi** shaxsiy **kotibidek** buyruq beradi.

sentences.text: She dresses **as though** she were going to a wedding every day.
sentences.translation: U **xuddi** har kuni to'yga **borayotgandek** kiyinadi.

sentences.text: Don't speak to me **as if** I was a child — I'm twenty-five!
sentences.translation: Men bilan **xuddi** yosh **boladek** gaplashma — yigirma beshdaman!

sentences.text: Tom drives through the city centre **as if** he owned the road.
sentences.translation: Tom shahar markazida **xuddi** yo'l o'zining **mulkidek** mashina haydaydi.

sentences.text: Sarah behaves **as though** she were the only person in the office who works hard.
sentences.translation: Sara o'zini **xuddi** ofisda faqat o'zi astoydil **ishlaydigandek** tutadi.

sentences.text: Aziz looked at me **as if** I were mad when I suggested walking to Chorsu.
sentences.translation: Chorsugacha piyoda borishni taklif qilganimda, Aziz menga **xuddi** aqldan **ozgandek** qaradi.

sentences.text: The government talks **as though** the economy were booming, but people feel poorer.
sentences.translation: Hukumat **xuddi** iqtisodiyot **gullab-yashnayotgandek** gapiradi, ammo odamlar qashshoqlashayotganini his qilmoqda.

sentences.text: Kate acted **as if** she didn't know me, although we'd studied together for three years.
sentences.translation: Uch yil birga o'qiganimizga qaramay, Keyt o'zini **xuddi** meni **tanimaydigandek** tutdi.

sentences.text: You talk **as if** you were the only one who's tired — we've all worked twelve hours!
sentences.translation: **Xuddi** faqat sen **charchagandek** gapirasan — hammamiz o'n ikki soat ishladik!

examples.title: Real or unreal? **as if he is** / **as if he was**
examples.description: Taassurot rost bo'lishi mumkin — oddiy zamon («-ganga o'xshaydi»); aniq rost emas — o'tgan zamon («xuddi ... -gandek»).

sentences.text: Tom sounds **as if** he's got a cold — let's not go near him.
sentences.translation: Tomning ovozi **shamollaganga o'xshaydi** — yoniga yaqinlashmaylik.

sentences.text: Tom always speaks **as if** he were an expert on every subject.
sentences.translation: Tom doim **xuddi** har bir mavzuda **mutaxassisdek** gapiradi.

sentences.text: It looks **as if** the shop is closing down — everything is half price.
sentences.translation: Do'kon **yopilayotganga o'xshaydi** — hamma narsa yarim narxda.

sentences.text: That shop treats customers **as if** they were criminals and searches every bag.
sentences.translation: U do'kon xaridorlarga **xuddi jinoyatchilarga qilgandek** muomala qiladi va har bir sumkani tekshiradi.

sentences.text: You look **as if** you need a holiday — why don't you take a week off?
sentences.translation: **Ta'tilga muhtojga o'xshaysan** — nega bir hafta dam olmaysan?

sentences.text: Nilufar spends money **as if** she were a millionaire, but she's always broke.
sentences.translation: Nilufar pulni **xuddi millionerdek** sarflaydi, lekin doim puli yo'q.

sentences.text: The sky looks **as though** it's going to clear up soon.
sentences.translation: Osmon tez orada **ochiladiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Oliver walked into the office **as though** he owned the place.
sentences.translation: Oliver ofisga **xuddi** uning **egasidek** kirib keldi.

sentences.text: Bekzod seems **as if** he's worried about something, but he won't tell us what.
sentences.translation: Bekzod nimadandir **xavotirdaga o'xshaydi**, lekin nima ekanini bizga aytmayapti.

sentences.text: Bekzod's brother behaves **as if** he were the head of the family, although he's the youngest.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning ukasi eng kichigi bo'lsa ham, o'zini **xuddi** oila **boshlig'idek** tutadi.

examples.title: Dialogue: the new manager
examples.description: Ikki hamkasb yangi rahbar haqida gaplashadi: taxmin (looks as if) va haqiqatga zid o'xshatish (as though we were) bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Have you met the new manager? He walks around **as if** he owns the building.
sentences.translation: — Yangi rahbarni ko'rdingmi? **Xuddi** bino **unikidek** yuradi.

sentences.text: — I know! And he talks to us **as though** we were his students.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman! Biz bilan **xuddi o'quvchilaridek** gaplashadi.

sentences.text: — Maybe he's just nervous. On Monday he looked **as if** he hadn't slept.
sentences.translation: — Balki shunchaki hayajondadir. Dushanba kuni u **uxlamaganga o'xshardi**.

sentences.text: — Nervous? He gave his first speech **as if** he'd been here for twenty years!
sentences.translation: — Hayajonda? Birinchi nutqini **xuddi** bu yerda yigirma yil **ishlagandek** so'zladi!

sentences.text: — It sounds **like** you really don't like him.
sentences.translation: — Uni rostdan ham **yoqtirmayotganga o'xshaysan**.

sentences.text: — It's not that. I just feel **as if** nobody asked our opinion.
sentences.translation: — Gap unda emas. Shunchaki **go'yo** hech kim fikrimizni **so'ramagandek** his qilyapman.

sentences.text: — Well, it looks **as though** he's planning lots of changes.
sentences.translation: — Nima ham derdim, ko'p o'zgarishlar **rejalashtirayotganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: — Exactly, and he acts **as if** the old system was a total disaster.
sentences.translation: — Ana shu-da, eski tizimni **go'yo** butunlay barbod **bo'lgandek** ko'rsatadi.

sentences.text: — Give him a chance. It feels **as if** we're judging him too quickly.
sentences.translation: — Unga imkon ber. Uni juda shoshilib **baholayotganga o'xshaymiz**.

sentences.text: — Maybe you're right, though he still looks **as if** he's never smiled in his life!
sentences.translation: — Balki haqdirsan, garchi u hali ham umrida bir marta ham **jilmaymagandek** ko'rinsa ham!

examples.title: Mixed: news, work and daily life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: look / sound / feel / seem as if, harakat tarzi va haqiqatga zid o'xshatish murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Judging by the queues, it looks **as if** the whole city has come to the new shopping centre.
sentences.translation: Navbatlarga qaraganda, butun shahar yangi savdo markaziga **kelganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: The minister answered the questions **as though** he hadn't read the report at all.
sentences.translation: Vazir savollarga **xuddi** hisobotni umuman **o'qimagandek** javob berdi.

sentences.text: You sound **as if** you've got a sore throat — would you like some honey and lemon?
sentences.translation: Tomog'ing **og'riyotganga o'xshaydi** — asal va limon beraymi?

sentences.text: After six months of remote work, going back to the office felt **like** starting a new job.
sentences.translation: Olti oy masofadan ishlagandan keyin ofisga qaytish **xuddi** yangi ishni **boshlashdek** tuyuldi.

sentences.text: Some politicians talk **as if** climate change were a problem for the next century.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi siyosatchilar **xuddi** iqlim o'zgarishi kelasi asrning **muammosidek** gapiradi.

sentences.text: It seems **as though** fewer people are buying cars in the city centre these days.
sentences.translation: Shu kunlarda shahar markazida mashina sotib oluvchilar **kamayganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza stared at the screen **as if** she couldn't believe her exam results.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **xuddi** imtihon natijalariga **ishona olmayotgandek** ekranga tikilib qoldi.

sentences.text: The new phone feels **as though** it's made of plastic, not metal.
sentences.translation: Yangi telefon **xuddi** metalldan emas, plastmassadan **yasalgandek** tuyuladi.

sentences.text: Why does James always act **as if** he's the only person who understands technology?
sentences.translation: Nega Jeyms doim o'zini **xuddi** texnologiyani faqat o'zi **tushunadigandek** tutadi?

sentences.text: When Aziz finally got his visa, he looked **as though** he'd won a gold medal.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat viza olganida, Aziz **xuddi** oltin medal **yutgandek** ko'rinardi.
